Every other line identical (all lines of the other types, and the I, L, J, O lines of turns 1 to 3); harness telemetry identical except turn times. Build id: a harness build of source_commit, 2 turns of game 3's save: the H line has seven fields, the seventh 'unknown' (harness builds compile a temporary copy that git does not track); research/ai-warfare/tools/extract.py reads it into wl_H.build, and reads game 3's log (six fields) with build NULL, 0 errors each. Snapshot (commit 3af6c89): harness builds of the same source and of main d51ff25: a 20-turn continuation of game 3's save, same seed, WAR_LOG_SEAT = 13 (seat 12 tracked). Telemetry identical (22 lines); every war-log line of the types main writes identical (1187) once the appended fields are cut; 19 turn starts with 1674 L, 49 J, 310 O lines, parsed by research/ai-warfare/tools/extract.py with 0 errors; the first snapshot agrees with the save's unit dump in type, experience, level and promotions for every unit in both; all 89 units built and all 49 combats' ids join the unit lines. Turn time: 73.3 s against 70.2 s (one run each); profile: the turn-start logging is under 1.6 % of turn time. The release DLL itself was not run headless
